/.title: Spirit Seeds Wellness | Melissa Carey, Massage and Yoga in Lafayette, CO
/.description: Melissa Carey, the owner and founder of Spirit Seeds Wellness, is an intuitive healer and trauma informed yoga teacher. With over two decades of experience, she blends holistic wellness practices, including thai massage therapy and crystal bowls sound healing, to create transformative healing experiences.

/about.title: About Melissa Carey | Spirit Seeds Wellness

/connect.description: Subscribe to the Spirit Seeds Wellness newsletter and follow along on social media: trauma-informed yoga, massage and holistic wellness in Lafayette, CO.

item.title: Monthly Bodywork Memberships
item.text: Your body thrives with consistent care. Rooted, Flourish and Thrive memberships make regular bodywork part of your self-care, with priority booking and member rates.
item.label: Explore Memberships

item.title: Book a Massage
item.text: Melissa uses tools from several modalities including Thai Yoga stretching, sound healing, passive Yin, reiki, and Abhyanga. We work intuitively to bring wellness to the whole person: mind, body and spirit.
item.label: Book a Massage

item.title: Subscribe to our newsletter
item.text: Welcome to a journey of healing and transformation! Subscribe to our newsletter for insights on trauma-informed yoga, neuroscience-based massage practices, and holistic wellness tips. Join our community today!
